method: Chicken: put the ghee or butter in a wide skillet over medium heat until melted. Add ground cardamom, black pepper, crushed chili, turmeric, cumin and salt; stir a few seconds until fragrant.
Add the finely chopped onion, crushed garlic, grated ginger and chopped green chili; stir until the mixture softens, colours slightly and smells fragrant.
Add the chicken pieces and stir so they are coated with the spices and onion and absorb the flavour.

Add the peeled chopped tomatoes, yogurt, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, chopped mint and chopped coriander. Stir, cover the skillet and cook 10 minutes. Add 1 cup water, cover again and cook 50 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and a little sauce remains.
Rice: rinse the basmati several times, then soak 30 minutes.
In a small cup combine the rose water and saffron; set aside.

In a large heavy-bottomed pot heat 3 tbsp ghee over medium heat. Fry the almonds until light golden, lift out with a slotted spoon and keep for garnish. Fry the raisins only until they plump, lift out and set aside.

In the same pot add the chopped onion, grated ginger, whole cardamom, whole cloves and cinnamon stick; stir 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant. Drain the rice and add it; stir gently so it takes the spice flavour. Add 4 cups water and boil on high heat until most of the water is absorbed and small holes appear on the surface of the rice.
Spread the chicken pieces evenly over the rice and pour the remaining sauce from the skillet on top. Cover the pot and cook on very low heat for 50 minutes until the rice is cooked and dry.

Lift the chicken off, fluff the rice with a fork and turn it onto a wide serving dish. Arrange the chicken on top, garnish with the fried almonds and raisins. Serve with salad or daqqous (tomato-chili sauce).
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 kg chicken cut into 8 pieces (bone-in implied; skin not specified)
rice_type_and_ratio: Basmati, 3 cups rice; 4 cups water for the rice stage (plus residual chicken sauce); soak 30 minutes after rinsing
spicy_ingredients_found: شطة مجروشة ½ ملعقة صغيرة (crushed chili flakes)
دقوس للتقديم (daqqous chili sauce, serving suggestion only)
notes: Page header says 31 ingredients / 10 steps. The saffron-rose water mixture (step 6) is prepared but the page never states when to add it; a cook would normally drizzle it over the rice before the final steaming. Green chili and chili flakes can be reduced or omitted for a mild household version. A second simpler version exists on the site: https://www.manalonline.com/برياني-الدجاج-البسيط/ (not extracted).

ingredients.item_en: meat cut into pieces (lamb or beef)

method: Wash the rice, changing the water several times until it runs clear. Soak in warm salted water about 30 minutes.
Soak the saffron in the rose water.

In a medium pot put the meat and cover with water. Add the quartered onion, cardamom, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, cloves, salt and black pepper. Boil 45 to 60 minutes until the meat is cooked. Lift out the meat; strain the broth and reserve 4 cups.
In a medium pot heat the oil or ghee. Add the minced onion, garlic and ginger and cook until the onion turns dark brown.
Add the boiled meat and the mixed spice; stir 4 to 5 minutes until the meat colours golden. Add the mint, yogurt and the saffron-rose water; cook 4 to 5 minutes until a thick sauce forms.
In a medium pot bring the reserved broth to the boil, add the drained rice and cook until done.

Add half the cooked rice to the meat and sauce and fold gently. Spread the remaining rice on top without stirring. Cover and leave on a gentle simmer 10 to 15 minutes so the rice absorbs the meat and spice flavour. Serve topped with the chopped boiled eggs and some fresh coriander.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 kg lamb or beef cut into pieces; cut and bone not specified
rice_type_and_ratio: 'Walima' rice (long-grain), 3 cups; cooked in 4 cups reserved meat broth; soak about 30 minutes in warm salted water
notes: Black pepper is used in the method but has no quantity in the ingredient list. Uses boiled eggs as garnish (traditional Gulf style). The 2 tbsp mixed spice may contain chili depending on the blend bought.

method: Wash the rice and soak it in warm water about 15 minutes.
Slice the eggplant, sprinkle lightly with salt and leave a few minutes; wipe the salt off well without rinsing.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and fry the eggplant slices until golden; set aside.
Cut the cooked chicken into small pieces of the size you like.
In a medium pot layer: a little rice, then the eggplant slices, then the chicken pieces, then the rest of the rice.
Pour the chicken stock into a bowl and add the salt, mixed spices, turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom and black pepper. Pour it carefully over the rice, then add the 2 tbsp oil.
Place the pot on high heat until it boils, then lower the heat, cover and simmer gently about 30 minutes until the rice is fully cooked.
Invert the pot onto a serving plate, sprinkle with fried pine nuts and serve hot.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 kg pre-boiled chicken, cut into small pieces; cut/bone/skin not specified
rice_type_and_ratio: Short-grain rice, 2½ cups; 3½ cups chicken stock; soak about 15 minutes in warm water
notes: Manal's version uses already-boiled chicken (the stock from boiling it is the cooking liquid). Alternative verified source: Samira Bisharat on Sayidaty Kitchen, 'مقلوبة الباذنجان المميزة خطوة بخطوة بالصور', https://kitchen.sayidaty.net/node/845/مقلوبة-الباذنجان-المميزة-خطوة-بخطوة-بالصور/وصفات-طبخ/خطوة-بخطوة , serves 8: 2 skinless chickens cut up and marinated in lemon juice, 4 cups Egyptian rice, 2 large eggplants sliced and fried, ½ tsp each mixed spice / cinnamon / black pepper / safflower, 1 tsp salt, 1 sliced onion, 1 cup vermicelli, 2 tbsp ghee, ¾ cup corn oil, 6 cups water (3 + 3), 1 cup toasted almonds; chicken browned dry in a pot, onion, ghee and spices added, 3 cups water boiled 10 min, half the eggplant layered on, rice and vermicelli fried 10 min in the oil with spices then spread on top, remaining 3 cups water added, boiled then simmered until done, inverted, served with almonds, salad and yogurt. No chili in either version.

method: Rice: rinse, soak in warm water 15 to 20 minutes, then drain.
Eggplant: peel and slice 1 cm thick, sprinkle with a little salt and leave about 30 minutes. Fry in oil and drain on paper towels.

Meat: put the meat, quartered onion, salt and the spices (mixed spice, cinnamon, black pepper, turmeric) in a large pot. Add 6 to 7 cups water, cover and boil until the meat is tender, 50 to 60 minutes. Lift out the meat. Strain the broth and top up with water to make 5 cups.
Assembly: in a large pot fry the onion slices in the ghee (or oil) until golden. Arrange the meat over the onion, place the fried eggplant along the sides, then spread the rice on top.
Carefully pour in the 5 cups broth. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low heat 30 to 35 minutes until the rice is done.
Invert the maqluba onto a round serving plate and garnish with the fried nuts.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1½ kg meat cut into pieces; type (lamb/beef) and cut not specified
rice_type_and_ratio: Basmati, 3 cups rice; 5 cups broth; soak 15 to 20 minutes in warm water
notes: Title on the page is simply 'المقلوبـة' (with a tatweel). Page meta says 12 ingredients, 6 steps. Fat for frying the eggplant is not quantified.

dish_en: Yellow Rice with Peri-Peri Grilled Chicken
dish_ar: أرز أصفر بالكركم مع دجاج بيري بيري
recipe_title_ar: طريقة عمل الأرز الأصفر بالكركم + دجاج البيري بيري المشوي من المطبخ البرتغالي
servings_stated: Rice: 4 (prep 10 min, cook 20 min). Chicken: 4 (cook 90 min)
method: RICE: melt the butter in a pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and stir until the onion softens.
Add the rice and turmeric and stir until well coated.
Add the hot broth, thyme, salt and pepper. Stir, cover and let the rice absorb the broth, then stir once more.
Lower the heat, cover and let the rice cook gently until done. Page tip: liquid should stand about 4 cm above the rice and must be hot.
CHICKEN: in a blender put the hot red chili, roasted bell pepper, chili powder, garlic and tomato paste; blend well.
Add the vinegar, corn oil and ground bay leaf; blend again at medium speed. Season with salt, black pepper, mixed spices, paprika and sweet spice and blend about 5 minutes more.
Wash the chicken, drain, put in a bowl and brush the sauce over it on all sides.
Refrigerate the chicken in the sauce at least 12 hours.
Place the chicken on a tray lined with aluminium foil and roast in an oven preheated to 220 C for about 90 minutes until cooked through. Remove and serve.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 whole chicken about 1200 g (skin-on, roasted whole); cutting not specified
rice_type_and_ratio: Basmati, 1 large cup rice; 1½ large cups hot chicken broth; no soak time given
spicy_ingredients_found: فلفل أحمر حار 1 (hot red chili, in peri-peri sauce)
شطة بودرة 1 ملعقة صغيرة (chili powder, in peri-peri sauce)
notes: No peri-peri chicken recipe exists on manalonline.com or kitchen.sayidaty.net (Sayidaty has only a peri-peri sauce page, node/26139). Both components taken from shamlola.com. The chicken page title says 'grilled' but the method is oven-roasted at 220 C for 90 min. Image URLs are the main recipe images shown on the page; og:image meta could not be confirmed. The chili and chili powder are the defining heat of peri-peri; reduce for children. An alternative shamlola yellow rice (الأرز البسمتي بالكركم, 3 cups rice : 3 cups broth) contains a dried hot chili and had apparent typos, so was not used.

ingredients.item_ar: لحم ضاني (كتف أو فخذ، بالعظم، قطع متوسطة)
ingredients.item_en: lamb shoulder or leg, bone-in, medium pieces

method: Peel, wash and dice the onions small.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pot over medium heat; add the onion and stir about 7 minutes until soft and light golden.
Add the lamb pieces and brown a few minutes on each side until golden.
Add cinnamon sticks, bay leaves, cardamom, cloves and dried limes, then the ground cinnamon, ground cardamom, black pepper and salt; stir a few minutes until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and stir a few minutes, then add the tomato sauce and the 4 cups water.
Cook over medium-high heat about 60 minutes until the meat is very tender, adding water as needed.
Lift the meat out of the broth and set aside. Strain the broth to remove onion and whole spices and keep it for the rice.
Wash the basmati several times until the water runs clear, then soak 30 minutes.
Put the meat pieces in the bottom of the rice pot. Pour over the strained broth, using exactly 4½ cups liquid for the 3 cups rice (top up with water if short; set aside any excess).
Add the drained rice and 1 tsp salt, raise the heat and cook about 5 minutes until the liquid starts boiling.
Cover tightly, lower the heat and cook 25 minutes. Turn off the heat and fluff gently with a fork.
Garnish: heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat, stir the almonds constantly until lightly golden and remove; add the raisins to the same pan and stir 1 to 2 minutes until warm.
Serve on a large platter: a layer of rice, meat on top, garnished with almonds, raisins and parsley. Serve hot.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1.5 kg lamb shoulder or leg, bone-in, medium pieces
rice_type_and_ratio: Long-grain basmati, 3 cups rice; 4½ cups strained meat broth; soak 30 minutes
notes: Published 2026-10-06 by Sayidaty Kitchen, Saudi cuisine. Chosen because it is the most complete classic version (explicit cut, liquid ratio, timings). Alternative verified: 'الكبسة السعودية باللحمة على أصولها' https://kitchen.sayidaty.net/node/37722/... (serves 4, 1 kg lamb, 3 cups basmati, kabsa spice, no liquid amount given). A video version by chef Sulaiman Al-Qurbi (node/9191, YouTube Csa4JUM0Cjc) is a 1-portion quick version, not suitable.

chef: مطعم المطبخ السعودي - دبي (published by مطبخ سيدتي)
recipe_title_ar: كبسة الدجاج على الطريقة السعودية التقليدية
method: Melt the butter in a large pot.
Add the chicken pieces, garlic and onion; fry until the onion is soft and the chicken is golden brown.
Add the pureed tomato and simmer on low heat a few minutes.
Add the fresh tomatoes, grated carrots, cloves, salt, black pepper and the mixed kabsa spices (saffron, cinnamon, baharat, dried lime, cardamom, nutmeg, cumin, coriander); cook a few minutes.
Add the 4 cups hot water, bring to the boil, reduce the heat and cover.
Simmer covered on low heat 30 minutes.
Add the rice, stir well and cover again; cook on low heat 35 to 40 minutes.
Add the raisins during the last 10 minutes and continue until the rice is done.
Spread the rice on a large platter, top with the chicken and almonds. Serve with a hot sauce (daqqous) on the side.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1.5 kg chicken cut into 8 to 10 pieces (bone-in implied; skin not specified)
rice_type_and_ratio: Basmati, 2¼ cups rice; 4 cups hot water added to the chicken stew (rice cooked in that liquid); no soak time stated
notes: Hot sauce is only a serving suggestion. Alternative verified classic with YouTube video by Manal Alalem on Sayidaty: 'الكبسة السعودية بالفيديو' https://kitchen.sayidaty.net/node/4022/الكبسة-السعودية-بالفيديو/وصفات-طبخ/وصفات-الفيديو (serves 5; 3 cups basmati, ½ cup corn oil, 2 large onions, 4 garlic, 3 green peppers halved, 3 loomi, 10 cardamom, 10 cloves, 1 cinnamon stick, 1 tbsp mixed spice, 1 tbsp salt, ¼ tsp black pepper, 3 tbsp tomato paste, 3 large tomatoes, 1 kg chicken; chicken boiled in the sauce, removed and grilled with tomato paste and turmeric, rice cooked in the broth 30 min on low; video https://www.youtube.com/embed/It3098fXmBs; no measured liquid). Manal's own site also has كبسة الدجاج: https://www.manalonline.com/كبسة-الدجاج/ (not extracted). A newer Sayidaty 'الكبسة بالدجاج السعودية على الطريقة الأصلية' (node/40702) uses orange zest and serves 3, judged less classic.

method: Wash the rice well, soak in warm water 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat the ghee in a wide pot. Add the chicken pieces and turn until golden on both sides; remove and set aside.
In the same pot sauté the onion until soft. Add the garlic, grated tomatoes and tomato paste and stir well.
Add the spices (salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, ground cinnamon, cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, bay leaves). Cook until the tomatoes break down and the mixture darkens.
Add the grated carrot and stir briefly until it softens. Return the chicken to the pot.
Add the 4 cups stock and simmer over medium heat 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked.

Remove the chicken temporarily. Add the soaked rice to the remaining stock, place the chicken gently back on top, cover and cook on very low heat 25 minutes until the rice is cooked and all liquid absorbed.
Fluff the rice gently. Serve on a large platter with the chicken on top, garnished with extra grated carrot or toasted almonds.
Serve with mint yogurt sauce or a hot tomato-garlic-lemon sauce.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 whole chicken cut into 8 pieces (bone-in; skin not specified)
rice_type_and_ratio: Long-grain basmati, 2½ cups rice; 4 cups chicken stock; soak 20 minutes in warm water
notes: Hot sauce is only a serving suggestion. Carrot and cinnamon appear twice in the list (stew use and garnish / ground and stick). Other Sayidaty versions checked: node/22744 'أرز بخاري بالدجاج على الطريقة السعودية' (6 thighs, 2 cups basmati, no liquid amounts) and node/33822 (boneless breasts, 1½ cups rice). Manal Alalem also has 'الأرز البخاري بالدجاج' at https://www.manalonline.com/الأرز-البخاري-بالدجاج/ (not extracted).

servings_stated: 4 أشخاص (4 people); cook time stated 60 min (method simmers meat 1½ hours)
method: Heat the oil in a pot. Add the carrots and stir until slightly softened.
Add the dark raisins and stir until they plump slightly. Remove the carrots and raisins and set aside.
In the same pot add the onions and sauté until soft.
Add the meat with the spices: bay leaves, cinnamon stick, cardamom, salt, black pepper (and the roasted cumin).
Add the blended tomatoes and tomato paste; stir the mixture 10 minutes.
Add about 6 cups water and simmer the meat 1½ hours until very tender.
Lift the meat out; grill it or keep aside as preferred.
Add the soaked rice to the meat broth, with the liquid level slightly above the rice.
Cook over medium heat until the rice begins to absorb the liquid, about 5 to 6 minutes.
Spread the reserved carrots and raisins over the rice, cover and cook on low heat 20 minutes.
Serve on a platter topped with the meat and garnished with the carrots and raisins (golden raisins as well).
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 kg meat in medium pieces; type (lamb) and cut not specified
rice_type_and_ratio: Basmati, 2 cups rice; about 6 cups water used to cook the meat, rice then cooked in the broth with liquid just above the rice level (no exact cup ratio); soak 30 minutes
notes: Published 2026-05-25. The page does not say exactly when the roasted cumin or the golden raisins are added. Other Sayidaty versions exist: node/19304 (video, Eid lamb bukhari), node/10754, node/39105 'بخاري اللحم مثل المطاعم' (not extracted).

method: In a wide bowl mix the curry powder, cumin, turmeric, paprika, coriander, chili flakes, salt and black pepper until even.
Put the oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add the onions and stir several minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and green chili; stir until the ginger smells fragrant.
Rub each chicken piece thoroughly with the spice mix and lay it on the onion mixture; repeat with all pieces, then add any leftover spice. Stir the chicken over high heat until it changes colour.
Add the coconut milk and water, cover and cook 50 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked.
Add the cream and let it boil just 1 minute, then add the chopped coriander.
Pour into a serving dish, sprinkle with fried cashews and serve with white rice.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 kg chicken cut into 8 pieces (bone-in implied; skin not specified)
rice_type_and_ratio: Not a rice dish; served with white rice
spicy_ingredients_found: شطة مجروشة 1 ملعقة صغيرة (crushed chili flakes)
قرن فلفل أخضر 2 (green chili peppers, sliced)
notes: The source recipe contains NO boiled egg; the household's 'boiled egg' addition is not from this page and should be marked as a household addition (halve eggs and add at serving). Video ID inferred from the embedded YouTube thumbnail. Manal's site also has 'كاري الدجاج الحار' (hot chicken curry) which was deliberately not chosen. Chili flakes and green chili can be reduced for a milder family version.

method: In a small bowl mix the cumin, turmeric, paprika, chili flakes, salt, black pepper, oregano and basil.
Rub half the spice mix over the chicken, working it under the skin and into the meat. Put the chicken in a medium baking dish.
Scrub the potatoes well under running water with a vegetable brush; do not peel.
Cut the potatoes into medium cubes on a board and put in a deep bowl.
Cut the red, green and yellow peppers into medium cubes and add to the potatoes. Add the whole garlic cloves. Cut the onion into squares and add.
Sprinkle the remaining spice mix and the olive oil over the vegetables and toss with your fingertips until fully coated.
Spread the vegetable mixture over the chicken in the dish.
Bake 60 minutes until the chicken and vegetables are cooked through (oven temperature not stated on the page; cover/foil not mentioned).
Remove from the oven, sprinkle with parsley and serve with white rice.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 kg chicken, skin-on (spices are rubbed under the skin); whole vs pieces not specified
rice_type_and_ratio: Not a rice dish; served with white rice
spicy_ingredients_found: شطة مجروشة 1 ملعقة صغيرة (crushed chili flakes)
notes: Oven temperature is missing on the page; a standard 180 to 200 C would need to be added as an editorial note. Video ID inferred from the embedded YouTube thumbnail. Chili flakes can be omitted for a mild version.

ingredients.item_ar: كزبرة خضراء أو بقدونس مفروم للتزيين
ingredients.item_en: fresh coriander or chopped parsley, garnish

method: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the onion and stir until it wilts and turns golden.
Add the garlic and stir about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken pieces and stir until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped tomatoes and tomato paste and stir 3 minutes.
Add salt, black pepper, turmeric, cumin, ground coriander and paprika; mix well.
Pour in the broth or water, add the dried limes if using, and bring to the boil.
Lower the heat, cover and cook the chicken 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots and cook 10 minutes.
Add the zucchini and green pepper and simmer gently 10 to 15 minutes more until the vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Taste and adjust salt and seasoning.
Garnish with coriander or parsley. Serve hot with white rice or Arabic bread.
chicken_or_meat_spec: 1 kg chicken cut into pieces; cut/bone/skin not specified
rice_type_and_ratio: Not a rice dish; served with white rice or bread
notes: Published 2026-08-17. Green pepper is the sweet variety (not flagged as hot). A plainer Sayidaty 'صالونة الدجاج' exists (node/25452, serves 2, 2 thighs, potatoes, carrot, loomi, no water amount) but was less complete; https://kitchen.sayidaty.net/node/25452/صالونة-الدجاج/وصفات-طبخ/وصفات
